posts.text:
US workers who are functionally illiterate earn roughly the same per hour as the average British worker.

“America is so rich that people who can’t read or count manage to out-earn average and somewhat above-average smarts Brits.

Young people in Britain are some of the most well-educated in the rich world, but economic stagnation means that breeds not growth but frustration.

You cannot understand just how poor Briton is making life for its citizens.” — h/t @jburnmurdoch  & @cremieuxrecueil
